title: Smelly, Dense, and Spreaded: The Object Detection for Olfactory References (ODOR) Dataset
reasoning: The paper focuses on computer vision and the creation of an object detection dataset for olfactory references in historical artworks. It evaluates technical model performance and dataset properties; it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics, although religious themes are present in the subject matter of some of the artworks used.
